auth.phoneSubtitle: We'll text you a code to sign in. No passwords, ever.
auth.errorInvalidCode: That code is wrong. Check it and try again.
auth.errorExpiredCode: This code has expired. Request a new one.
auth.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts — wait a bit before trying again.
auth.errorDisallowedCountry: We can't send codes to that country yet.
